title: POST /api/integration/client-token (4xx/5xx)
description: Error body. Integration reaction by status: 404 client_not_found and 409 client_inactive -> remove the device user (the device is gone or pending deletion); 422 -> bug or request_required (delivery not bound to an open request), log and keep the user; the next provisioning request heals it; 401/403 -> integration token rotated, Supervisor re-discovery heals; 503 db_unavailable and network errors -> keep user and token, retry on the next request/poll (the hub keeps the device in provisioning[]).
